patch.summary: Kaspr cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Kaspr pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Kaspr cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Kaspr against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when EMEA/EU-leaning SMB and mid-market teams prospecting via LinkedIn + Chrome requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Reporting is lighter than enterprise SI/ABM suites

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Monthly billing is higher than annual headline — model carefully

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a full enterprise predictive ABM or mega-database platform
